description: This file defines the interface and implementation of a resource monitoring system within the WPEFramework. It includes the IResource interface, the ResourceMonitorType template class managing resources, worker threads, and platform-specific event handling, as well as a singleton ResourceMonitor class. The code manages resource registration, event polling, and thread control for Linux, Windows, and macOS platforms.

classes.name: IResource
classes.description: Interface representing a resource with a descriptor, event notifications, and a handle method.

classes.name: ResourceMonitorType
classes.description: Template class managing resources, monitoring threads, and platform-specific event handling.

classes.name: ResourceMonitor
classes.description: Singleton class providing access to the resource monitor instance.

methods.name: Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ResourceMonitor.
